canonical_data: A local application-data directory holding config, a SQLite-backed database, installed capability bundles, and the agent's file workspace.
strengths: Path-driven and event-driven scheduled task automation
Telegram and web chat frontends alongside the terminal REPL
weaknesses: Reliability claims rest on a self-published benchmark, not independent evaluation
Companion web UI has no documented production deployment path outside a macOS-specific proxy
Single maintainer with a modest track record and no documented approval/audit trail for autonomous actions
Limited documented observability into task/tool failures
why_it_matters: Shows a model-agnostic, self-hosted general work agent that pairs scheduled file and messaging automation with a durable, self-maintaining memory bundle.
